issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dandelion, azure_bluet.
1 fence/pane/wall block(s) have no north/east/south/west set although a neighbour would connect, so they show as lone posts: (5, 1, 4).
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Cottage level 2: porch, flower boxes, lanterns and a path make it charming; the roof is still one flat oak colour.
problems: Levels 2 and 3 look almost the same (level 3 only adds a wood pile at the back): give level 3 its own visible feature, such as a jettied upper gable, a lean-to woodshed or a garden fence with a gate (Carlton's carpenter and watchtower notes).
The roof is one oak colour and flush at the gable ends: dark oak eaves, a slab ridge and one block of overhang at the front and back.
One fence inside at (5, 1, 4) still shows as a lone post (Carlton: "fences also still seems bugged"); and on level 3 the fences at (1, 0, 0) and (7, 0, 0).
The pale squares in the gables read as blank patches, not windows; use glass panes with trapdoor shutters.
